component.name: Mouse Macro Stocazz Superpower
component.summary: Record mouse gestures and replay them
Registra i gesti del mouse e li ripete

description.p: A small panel that records mouse movements, clicks, double clicks, drags and the wheel, then replays them from 1 to 999 times, at normal or double speed.
Un piccolo pannello che registra movimenti, clic, doppi clic, trascinamenti e rotella del mouse e li ripete da 1 a 999 volte, a velocità normale o doppia.

ul.li: Compact semi-transparent activity bar with counters and a large Stop button
Optional Ctrl+Tab between cycles, slow pages and human-like movement
Global F9/F10 shortcuts and Ctrl+Alt+F11 / Ctrl+Shift+F11 emergency stop
Records the mouse only: no keyboard logging, no screenshots

description.p: Reading the mouse and the global shortcuts needs access to input devices: install the udev uaccess rule described in the documentation. Movements are relative: start each replay from the same cursor position.
